case.summary: Case HHG-016 covers a online $59.67 transaction 3534820 on card C09988-K1 raised by a customer_report trigger. Graph investigation found 4 corroborating signal(s) - new device, 48h burst, shared-device ring, device linked to prior fraud. Pattern assessed as card not present new device; fraud probability 0.72 before additional evidence and 0.87 after, giving a verdict of fraud. Exposure across 2 transaction(s) is $194.64. Independent graph signals corroborate the finding, so the actions below follow from the policy routes shown with each one.

The cardholder reported the purchase as unauthorised in the customer_report trigger for case HHG-016, stating they did not make it. It arrived from device profile DP-c388f53a1a0021d6, recorded as New and serving 158 card(s) across 158 customer(s). Card C09988-K1 already had 48 online authorisation(s) in the preceding 48 hours. Device profile DP-c388f53a1a0021d6 also appears on confirmed-fraud case(s) CC-0014, CC-0031, CC-0033 involving other cards, indicating a common actor. Card(s) C00005-K1, C00045-K1, C00294-K2, C00426-K2 share that device profile and are placed under monitoring. The activity is assessed as card not present new device under policy R6. Total unauthorised amount across 2 transaction(s) is $194.64 between 1970-01-18 and 1970-01-18. Card C09988-K1 is recommended for blocking and reissue, an internal case is opened, and the report awaits fraud-manager approval.
